			StartGrabSpamPunishment = function(arg, arg2)
				local v26 = GrabSpamKinds[arg2]
				GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = true
				notify(arg.DisplayName .. v26.Message)
				local n38 = 1020010313
				local n39 = 943322139

				task.spawn(function()
					local now = os.clock()

					if _G[v26.Enabled] then
						if arg.Parent then
							if os.clock() - now < 10 then
								while IsPlayerInsideSafeZone(arg) do
									task.wait(0.1)

									if _G[v26.Enabled] then
										if arg.Parent then
											if not (os.clock() - now < 10) then
												GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = nil
												return
											end
											continue
										end

										GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = nil
										return
									end

									GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = nil
									return
								end

								local v27 = pcall
								local v28 = ExecuteCounterAttack
								local v29 = arg

								while true do
									local v30 = table.pack(v27(v28, v29, _G[v26.Mode], true))
									local v31, v32

									if select("#", table.unpack(v30, 1, v30.n)) ~= 0 then
										v31 = v30[1]
										v32 = v30[2]
									else
										v31 = nil
										v32 = nil
									end

									local exitTo

									if v31 then
										if not v32 then
											exitTo = nil

											while true do
												task.wait(0.1)

												if _G[v26.Enabled] then
													if arg.Parent then
														if os.clock() - now < 10 then
															if IsPlayerInsideSafeZone(arg) then
																continue
															else
																exitTo = 1
																break
															end
														end
													end

													break
												else
													break
												end
											end

											if exitTo == 1 then
												v27 = pcall
												v28 = ExecuteCounterAttack
												v29 = arg
												continue
											end
										end
									else
										warn("[" .. arg2 .. " Punish] " .. tostring(v32))
										exitTo = nil

										while true do
											task.wait(0.1)

											if _G[v26.Enabled] then
												if arg.Parent then
													if os.clock() - now < 10 then
														if IsPlayerInsideSafeZone(arg) then
															continue
														else
															exitTo = 1
															break
														end
													end
												end

												break
											else
												break
											end
										end

										if exitTo == 1 then
											v27 = pcall
											v28 = ExecuteCounterAttack
											v29 = arg
											continue
										end
									end

									break
								end
							end
						else
							GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = nil
							return
						end
					else
						GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = nil
						return
					end

					GrabSpamPunishing[arg] = nil
				end)
			end

			RegisterGrabSpam = function(arg, arg2)
				local v26 = GrabSpamKinds[arg2]

				if _G[v26.Enabled] then
					if arg ~= localPlayer.Name then
						local v27 = PS:FindFirstChild(arg)

						if v27 then
							if not GrabSpamPunishing[v27] then
								local now = os.clock()
								local tbl4 = GrabSpamLog[arg2][arg] or {}
								GrabSpamLog[arg2][arg] = tbl4

								for i = #tbl4, 1, -1 do
									if now - tbl4[i] > 3 then
										table.remove(tbl4, i)
									end
								end

								table.insert(tbl4, now)

								if (_G[v26.Grabs] or 5) <= #tbl4 then
									table.clear(tbl4)
									StartGrabSpamPunishment(v27, arg2)
								end

								return
							end
						end

						return
					end
				end
			end

			RegisterAnchorGrab = function(arg)

			checkauto_os = function(arg)
				if typeof(arg) == "table" then
					local v26 = table.pack(pairs(arg))
					local v27, v28, v29

					if select("#", table.unpack(v26, 1, v26.n)) ~= 0 then
						v27 = v26[1]
						v28 = v26[2]
						v29 = v26[3]
					else
						v27 = nil
						v28 = nil
						v29 = nil
					end

					for k, v30 in v27, v28, v29 do
						if not IsNetworkOwner(v30.PartAnchored) then
							local v31 = k

							if v31.Parent then
								local v32 = SFcQ(v31)
								local head = v31:FindFirstChild("Head") or v32
								local playerFromCharacter = PS:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v31)
								local flag = false

								if playerFromCharacter then
									if _G.OwnershipModeTarget == 1 then
										flag = true
									elseif _G.OwnershipModeTarget == 3 then
										flag = true
									elseif playerFromCharacter == nil then
										if _G.OwnershipModeTarget == 2 then
											flag = true
										elseif _G.OwnershipModeTarget == 3 then
											flag = true
										end
									end
								elseif playerFromCharacter == nil then
									if _G.OwnershipModeTarget == 2 then
										flag = true
									elseif _G.OwnershipModeTarget == 3 then
										flag = true
									end
								end

								if v32 then
									if flag then
										if not (Getdistancefromcharacter(v32.Position) < 30) then
											if _G.OwnershipModeAnchorBehavior == "Teleport" then
												if v32.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
													for i = 0, 15 do
														if CNSOnPartAndSNOWship(head, v32) then
															print("Break the auto")
															break
														else
															SitOnVS(v31:FindFirstChildOfClass("VehicleSeat"), true, false)
															TeleportPlayer(v32.CFrame, 1.5, true)
															task.wait(0.1)
														end
													end
												end
											end
										else
											CNSOnPartAndSNOWship(head, v32)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					return
				end
			end

			autosetownership = function()
				checkauto_os(AnchoredObjects)
				wait()
